package.name: botwheel_explorer_deps
package.description: Meta-package that declares extra ROS / system dependencies needed by the BotWheel Explorer but not owned by any upstream (submodule) package. It builds nothing — its only job is to give `rosdep install --from-paths src` a manifest to read, so dependencies are installed at image build time without editing the Dockerfile or the upstream forks. Add new <exec_depend> entries here as the project grows.
